messages:
alex: Heads up — during last night’s canary we saw ~60% of newly launched spot GPUs get evicted within 5m, and the autoscaler immediately spawned replacements which amplified queue depth. Thinking we should temper scale-out aggressiveness for the spot pool and add a 'drainback' window before routing prod traffic to new nodes. WDYT?

maya: Oof. Which zone did this hit and do we have eviction logs? @ops-bot please paste the summary.

ops-bot: evictions summary: us-west1-b spike between 02:07–02:12 UTC. avg uptime before eviction: 3m. launch failures: 4.2% in same window. recent trend shows churn rising vs baseline.

samir: +1 on 'drainback'. Practical pattern: keep new spot nodes in a background-only state until model KV cache warms and GPUs finish initial setup. Also increase scale-out cooldown for spot pools (avoid replacing evicted nodes immediately) and cap concurrent launches to avoid thundering-herd.

alex: Proposed autoscaler pseudo-config (for discussion):

```
pool: spot-gpu
scale_out:
  trigger: queue_length > 10 OR gpu_util > 70 for 30s
  cooldown: 300s
  max_concurrent_launches: 2
  warm_up_delay: 180s   # don't route prod traffic until 3m or cache warm
surge_control:
  max_burst_tokens: 4
  refill_rate: 1/min
```

Also add randomized jitter to launch times so replacements don't all start at once.

kat: We should also add a fallback: if spot-eviction-rate > 20% in the last 15m, divert new allocations to dedicated pool (if commitments available) and raise a high-priority alert for SRE/PD. That avoids cost-free but unavailable capacity causing customer latency.

maya: Can we formalize an alert called `spot-churn-high`: trigger when eviction_rate > 15% AND replacement_rate > 40% over 15m. Automation can pause aggressive autoscaling and flip pool preference.

samir: Implementation notes: we need a token-bucket per-cluster to control concurrent launches, and per-model ramp counters so we don't route traffic until either warm_up_delay elapsed OR kv_hit_rate >= 0.8. Also add metrics: node_age_distribution, kv_hit_after_launch, and new_node_rejects.

alex: TL;DR for PR: 1) add warm_up_delay + max_concurrent_launches to autoscaler schema; 2) implement token-bucket surge control; 3) add churn-based failover to dedicated; 4) add `spot-churn-high` alert. Who wants to pair on the changes?

kat: :thumbsup: I can pair tomorrow AM. Also please attach the full logs to a postmortem once the PR lands so we have data for tuning.
